job.title: Intermediate Accountant
job.description:
Intermediate Accountant | Advisory Focus | Perth

Tired of compliance season running your life? This one's for accountants who want their day to look a bit different.

We're working with a well regarded Perth accounting firm looking to bring on an Intermediate Accountant who wants to build a career in Advisory, not just tax returns and financial statements on repeat. Think business advisory, forecasting, cash flow modelling, and actually sitting in the room when clients make decisions about their business.

What you'll be doing:

  • Working closely with clients on advisory-style projects, not just compliance
  • Involvement in forecasting, budgeting, and business performance conversations
  • Some traditional compliance work, but with a clear runway to shift the balance toward advisory over time
  • Working directly with Partners and Directors who want to develop your skillset, not just hand you a workload

What you'll bring:

  • CA or CPA (part-qualified or close to completing)
  • A couple of years' experience in a public practice environment
  • Someone who's keen to move beyond compliance and build genuine advisory skills
  • Confident communicator, comfortable in front of clients

Why apply:

  • Genuine career progression into advisory work, not just a title change
  • Supportive partners who invest in developing their people
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • A firm that actually wants to hear your ideas, not just process them

If you're an accountant who wants more from your day than compliance deadlines, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or reach out for a confidential chat.

job.title: Senior Auditor
job.description:
Senior Auditor | Perth | Public Practice

Our client is a long standing Perth practice with a strong reputation in the local market, built on the calibre of clients they act for. Expect exposure to some genuinely complex, multi entity groups and a large focus on the mining sector. 

What you'll be doing
  • Running audit engagements from planning through to sign off
  • Leading and mentoring junior staff on your jobs
  • Managing your own client relationships (you'll actually talk to clients, not just review someone else's file)
  • Reviewing financial statements and flagging risk areas
  • Having real input into how the team runs its audit process, not just following it
What we're looking for
  • CA or CPA qualified, or close to finishing
  • A few years' audit experience in public practice
  • Solid technical audit and reporting skills
  • Comfortable leading a small team and dealing directly with clients
  • Keen to help junior staff coming up behind you
On offer
  • Full study support through to CA/CPA
  • A real path to Audit Manager
  • Hybrid working, no rigid five days in office
  • Decent systems, so you're not stuck doing manual admin all day
  • Professional development and structured training

This search is confidential, so if you're keen to hear more before committing to anything, reach out to Faith on 0424336058
